title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google , meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Summary

As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you’ll be responsible for planning and executing strategies to drive customer adoption and use of the Wiz platform. You will provide both strategic and hands-on technical guidance to customers throughout the Wiz journey, from onboarding to operationalization.

Technical expertise and strong customer-facing skills will be essential in address both the business and technical needs of our customers. Serving as the bridge between customers and the broader Wiz team, you'll streamline collaboration between Product Management, Sales, Engineering and Support for a cohesive customer experience.

Join Wiz as a TAM to contribute to customer success and to be a part of an innovative and collaborative company that values excellence and growth.

What you’ll do

• Provide customers with expert guidance on deployment, operational best practices, and assist in establishing a Wiz Center of Excellence. Serve as the primary Wiz liaison for technical questions or escalations, collaborating with Support, Product Management, and other relevant teams. Contribute to workshops aimed at helping customers unlock the full value of the Wiz platform.

• Develop trusted advisor relationships and establish a regular cadence with customer stakeholders from practitioners to C-level, with a focus on increasing adoption, ensuring retention, and fostering satisfaction.

• Help customers develop Success Plans, outlining critical goals and key performance indicators, and provide guidance in achieving these objectives. Measure customers’ achievement of these key performance indicators and report those both internally and externally.

• Identify and address technical issues to ensure high levels of customer satisfaction. Collaborate with Engineering and Support teams to resolve technical escalations quickly and efficiently.

• Advocate for customer needs across various departments (product management, support, ...). Offer insights regarding the availability of new features in Wiz. Program manage account escalations effectively.

• Collaborate with the Wiz Sales and Renewal teams to secure contract renewals. Assist in identifying opportunities for expanding Wiz usage across the customer’s organization.

• Maintain up-to-date functional and technical knowledge of the Wiz platform. Continuously monitor news related to new & emerging cloud security threats. Grow your knowledge of the Wiz ecosystem (Cloud Service Providers, Technology partners, ...)

What you’ll bring

• 3+ years of experience in technical customer facing roles, for example: Technical Account Manager, Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, Customer Success

title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Support Operations
description:
Most companies treat support as a cost center. We treat it as an engineering challenge and a product opportunity.

Support Operations Engineering is an engineering function inside ClickHouse’s Support Services organization. We build the systems that decide how customers get help from the moment they describe their problem to the moment it’s resolved. This role will help shape how Support Services, RevOps, GTM, and core Engineering teams collaborate on customers. This is not a tools team. About a third of our work directly supports the support organization. The rest is building experiences and systems that change how ClickHouse works with its customers in more effective, streamlined ways.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

You’ll design and build the systems that sit between ClickHouse’s customers and the teams who serve them. The work is varied by design, and you’ll move between problem types as priorities shift:

- Intelligent routing and decision systems. Software that decides where work should go and who should handle it, weighing many signals at once, and is built to adapt as the business scales.

- AI-powered customer experiences. Customer-facing and internal experiences that understand what someone needs, recommend the best next step, and know when to hand off to a human.

- Internal platforms and tooling. Applications that give Support, RevOps, and GTM teams the leverage to work faster and more accurately, built to production standards.

- Integrations and data flow. Connections across Salesforce, live chat, incident management, Slack, GitHub, and more, so workflows and data move cleanly between systems.

- Automation and observability. Systems that remove repetitive work, surface what’s breaking, and give teams confidence in what they’re running.

Across all of it, you’ll partner with core Engineering to ship to production, and own what you build: code review, testing, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

WHAT YOU BRING ALONG:

- 3-5 years building and shipping full-stack software in production, with tools like TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and React (or comparable)

- Experience developing with APIs, webhooks, and integrations between distributed systems

- Hands-on experience close to support: as a support or technical support engineer, or by building tools or integrations for a support, CS, or RevOps team

- Confidence with Git and safe, version-controlled deployment workflows

- The ability to translate operational needs into solutions that non-engineers can follow

- A shipper’s mindset: self-driven, curious, and comfortable owning a problem end-to-end in a remote, globally distributed team

- Comfort using AI tools day to day in how you build, with a clear sense of where to trust them

BONUS POINTS:

- Experience building LLM-powered features in production (routing, retrieval, evaluation, or observability)

- Salesforce platform experience (Apex, LWC, Flows, custom objects) or certifications; if you don’t have it, the appetite to get there quickly

- Support and incident tooling: Pylon, incident.io http://incident.io, PagerDuty, Zendesk, Slack APIs, GitHub APIs

- Experience with ClickHouse or other analytical databases

- Experience in an early-stage or greenfield environment, or embedded in a support, RevOps, or business-systems function

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

- Global Gatherings - We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

title: Mechanical Engineer II (Onsite)
Product Designer- Cloud
description:
Company Overview
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for digital innovation and transformation. Our portfolio includes product lifecycle management, electronic design automation, low-code application development, and enterprise software solutions that help companies accelerate innovation and create lasting value. At Mendix, we empower organizations to build, deploy, and govern modern applications using our low-code platform. With the resources of a large company and the innovation of a software leader, we create solutions that enable our customers to achieve more.
Position Overview
Join the Cloud Unit within Mendix R&D, helping customers deploy, operate, and govern applications and platform environments. We make complex cloud capabilities, administration, and integrations easier to use. You'll help shape a new agentic platform, working with product managers, technical leads, and developers to frame problems, validate ideas, and deliver well-crafted experiences, including interactions between people and AI agents. AI is central to what we build and how we work. We value strong UX and UI craft through clear thinking, communication, rapid prototyping, and attention to the implemented experience, not just polished design files.

Why Us
We are Siemens:
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work-hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.
You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Our Benefits & Rewards
The salary range for this position is €60,000- €75,000 and this role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
Diversity & Inclusion
We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can bring their authentic self to work. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and experiences. We believe in building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Siemens is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
How We Work
You'll join a design team working across multiple product and development teams. We use Figma and AI-assisted tools, but specific tools are not a checklist. Functional prototyping is expected; production coding is not. Hybrid arrangements are agreed within the team.
Your Portfolio
Show how you think, collaborate, and learn, from problem framing to testing and delivery. Include work-in-progress artefacts, prototypes, and how findings changed your designs. Explain your contribution, trade-offs, and outcomes where available. We value an honest view of your process over a polished sales presentation.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми шукаємо Marketing Specialist, щоб разом піднімати планку результатів.

ЩО РОБИТЬ ЦЮ РОЛЬ ОСОБЛИВОЮ

- Масштаб тестування: гіпотези запускаються системно на широкому міксі каналів.

- Рутина автоматизована: автобриф для постановки задач, шаблони і готова структура для варіацій, AI-стек для текстовок і ресерчу. Свої автоматизації можна викатити на всю команду.

- Команда топових експертів ринку: User Acquisition, дизайн, MarTech та аналітика працюють пліч-о-пліч, і прямі партнерства з Meta і Google.

- Два треки розвитку: поглиблення експертизи до Senior Creative Marketer або перехід у лідерську роль Creative Lead.

ВИКЛИКИ, ЯКІ ЧЕКАЮТЬ НА ЦІЙ РОЛІ

- Досліджувати ринок і конкурентів через спай-тули (Meta Ad Library, Adheart і тп) та формувати на основі цього креативні гіпотези.

- Оформлювати гіпотези у ТЗ для дизайнерів і писати текстовки: хедлайни, дескрипшени, UGC-сценарії.

- Запускати тести разом з User Acquisition менеджерами, аналізувати результати і робити висновки для наступної ітерації.

- Масштабувати креативи, що показали результат, і створювати частину креативів самостійно за допомогою автоматизації і шаблонів.

ЩО ДЛЯ НАС ВАЖЛИВО

- 2+ роки досвіду у перформанс-маркетингу, зокрема повний цикл роботи з дизайнером - від постановки ТЗ і запуску до відповідальності за результат.

- Досвід роботи зі спай-тулами та аналізу конкурентів, інтерес до автоматизації процесів.

- Робота з метриками: вмієш аналізувати результати тестів та аргументувати рішення даними.

- Буде плюсом: базові навички Figma / Adobe, робота з рекламними кабінетами Meta / Google, англійська для написання текстовок.

ЩО ТИ ОТРИМАЄШ ДОДАТКОВО РАЗОМ З НАМИ

- Внутрішні клуби за професійними напрямками: аналітика, продукт, маркетинг, розробка, фінанси і рекрутинг.

- Тренінги, курси, відвідування конференцій.

- Світлі та сучасні офіси в Києві й Варшаві, а також можливість повністю працювати віддалено.

- Медичне страхування, корпоративний лікар.

 

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. title: Oncology Nurse Navigator
description:
CancerNavigator is an early-stage healthcare company (remote, headquartered in Washington, D.C.) dedicated to supporting cancer patients in their hour of need.
Our Mission & Our Work, in Brief
Cancer is the number one cause of death for commercially insured Americans and the top cost driver for health plans. And, cancer patients are struggling.
CancerNavigator is a white-glove, end-to-end, cancer support service for patients and their families. We work with health plans across the country to provide 1-1 support to members facing a cancer diagnosis. All of our support is delivered through dedicated Oncology Certified Nurses, who work with members to catch cancer early, get them to fantastic experts for their care, and help them through the thousands of other problems patients and their families face.
Join us to help serve cancer patients in their hour of need.
The “Nurse Navigator” Role
Our oncology nurse navigators are the front-line of CancerNavigator ’s patient service. Nurse Navigators support patients at all parts of their journey - newly diagnosed, in active treatment, and entering remission. With more specificity, oncology nurse navigators:

• Educate cancer patients (and their families) about their diagnosis, treatment options, and provide helpful information on any related questions and concerns the patient may have

• Work closely with the researchers on our team to deliver tailored information to patients, guiding them to the centers and doctors that would be a great option for the patient’s care

• Do everything possible to address any barriers to care (e.g. registering and scheduling appointments, coordinating with their health plan or their care team, transferring records, etc.)

• Provide longitudinal support to the patient throughout their journey - helping them solve any issues related to their cancer diagnosis and care - whether connecting patients to mental health support, finding resources to ease the financial burden, arranging transportation to appointments, or answering any questions that may arise

The Requirements
The main requirement of this role is oncology nursing experience and a passion for serving cancer patients. More specifically, we are looking for someone with the following experience and qualifications:

• Ability to work Eastern hours (8am-5pm EST)

• 3+ years of oncology nursing experience

• Mastery of common navigation and care coordination issues (registration, scheduling, clinical department navigation, insurance coordination, solving coverage issues, etc.)

• Mastery of basic computer tools (Gmail, Zoom, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)

• Preferred: Oncology Certified Nurse (OCN)

Compensation and Benefits

• Starting Salary Range: $100-115k (based on skills and experience)

• Dental and Healthcare (80% employer paid), Vision Insurance (100% employer paid)

• Healthcare and Dependent Care FSA

• Group Life and AD&D Insurance (involuntary with the option to buy up coverage)

• Unlimited PTO

• Remote-first work; live where you want within the region

• All-company on-sites 2-3x per year (in Washington DC & Denver)

Our Culture & Values, In Brief
We’re building a company where what we do matters. The goal couldn’t be clearer - serve cancer patients. As the business grows, and the work becomes more complex, we need to become more, not less, committed to why we are doing this.
We have three company values, which guide our work:

•
Patients first, always: In everything we do, we put the cancer patient (and their families) first; we exist to serve them in their most urgent moments.

•
Respect for our responsibility: We strive, as a team, to respect the gravity of the responsibility we bear to patients, always acting and producing in a way that is worthy of the trust they have placed in us.

•
Kindness to and respect for others: We treat our teammates well, no exceptions. We are one team.

Overview
A leading organization in the cybersecurity sector is seeking a Salesforce Business Analyst to join its internal Salesforce team. This role is ideal for a professional with both functional and technical knowledge of the Salesforce platform who enjoys collaborating with stakeholders and technical teams to deliver system improvements and business solutions.
The successful candidate will play a key role in project delivery and ongoing system enhancements, supporting initiatives from initial requirements gathering through testing, deployment, and post-implementation support. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions align with business needs while following established development, change, and release management processes.
Key Responsibilities

• Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders and translate business needs into structured documentation such as user stories, use cases, and backlog items.

• Analyze and document end-to-end business processes, including current-state (“as-is”) and future-state (“to-be”) workflows.

• Collaborate with stakeholders across multiple regions to understand operational differences and ensure alignment with the global system structure.

• Monitor project progress and identify potential risks or issues that may affect delivery timelines; escalate significant concerns to leadership when required.

• Support the transition of initiatives from project delivery to ongoing operational support, ensuring smooth handover to business-as-usual processes.

• Apply knowledge of change management and release management practices to ensure successful system updates and enhancements.

• Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including scheduling sessions, preparing test cases, and gathering business sign-off before deployment.

• Validate both functional and non-functional requirements, ensuring clear acceptance criteria are defined prior to development cycles and sprint planning.

• Maintain proactive communication with internal teams and stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives, timelines, and expected outcomes.

Prior experience working within the technology industry, particularly within professional services environments, is considered advantageous.

title: CAD Drafter
description:
Drafter / Takeoff Specialist - Commercial Roofing, Cladding & Architectural Sheet Metal
Role Overview
We are looking for detail-oriented Drafters to produce shop drawings and material takeoffs for commercial roofing, cladding and architectural sheet metal projects. Your takeoffs jump-start procurement so Project Managers can review, finalize and release material orders months before field measurements are available. We welcome candidates with experience in roofing, cladding, or sheet metal, or any combination of these. Candidates will be matched to project types based on their background.
Workflow

• Project is awarded and handed off from estimating to the PM.

• Drafter prepares shop drawings and completes the initial material takeoff from the same set, working primarily from contract/architectural drawings (DWG/PDF).

• Takeoff is reviewed with the team; Project Managers review and finalize before any order is placed.

• Takeoff/cut list is delivered to the PM as an organized Excel sheet (plus Autodesk layout exports where useful) so materials can be released to external suppliers.

• Turnaround is set per task and project scope. Tasks can range from a few hours to multi-week drawing sets.

Key Responsibilities

• Takeoffs: Perform quantity takeoffs from architectural and engineering drawings. Roofing: square footage, membrane (e.g., TPO/PVC), insulation board counts, fasteners, edge metal, flashing. Cladding and sheet metal: panel counts and lengths, clips, trims, flashing, coping, master-sheet optimization for ACM/MCM, and linear footage for field roll-forming.

• Cut lists & orders: Build supplier-ready cut lists and order data in Excel or via Autodesk export, following the templates and examples provided.

• Shop drawings: Produce shop drawings, roof plans, panel layouts, elevations and details in AutoCAD; mark up in Bluebeam.

• Review & release: Walk takeoffs through with the team, incorporate PM feedback, and release materials once finalized.

• Quality: Verify quantities against drawings, engineering, manufacturer specifications and local codes before release.

Requirements & Qualifications

• Experience: Drafting experience is the core requirement. An experienced superintendent / senior superintendent who has installed systems and done their own takeoffs is also a strong fit.

The VIP Growth Manager will serve as a central strategy and operations partner for the VIP business. Through data analysis, user insights, and cross-functional collaboration, this role will support VIP Relationship Managers and regional teams with growth strategies and initiatives.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical thinking and communication skills, with the ability to identify growth opportunities from user behavior and business data, translate insights into actionable plans, and collaborate with relevant teams to drive execution and continuous optimization.

 

VIP增长经理将作为VIP业务的核心策略与运营伙伴，通过数据分析、用户洞察及跨部门协作，为VIP客户关系经理（RM）及各区域团队提供增长策略与项目支持。

我们希望候选人具备较强的分析思维和沟通能力，能够从用户行为及业务数据中识别增长机会，将洞察转化为可执行的业务方案，并协同相关团队推动落地和持续优化。

Business Insights & Strategy

•
Identify structural problems and opportunities in the data, such as churn signals among high-value users, differences in service needs across client segments, and the marginal return on resource allocation, and turn them into actionable strategies.

•
Write business insight reports for senior management that shape VIP benefits, resource allocation, and team playbooks.

Data Monitoring

•
Build and maintain the VIP core metrics framework with daily monitoring; when a metric moves unexpectedly, find the root cause and recommend actionable next steps.

•
Automate recurring analyses and reports as dashboards or scheduled jobs (for example weekly and monthly reports, incentive plan results, and anomaly alerts) to reduce repetitive manual data pulls.

•
Work with the Data Warehouse and BI teams to standardize metric definitions and build data tables, so the data stays accurate and traceable.

Incentive Plan Design & Execution

Design and strategise incentive plans for VIP business teams, covering metric selection, target breakdown, weighting, and payout linkage.

Track how the incentive plans are carried out, deliver results weekly and monthly, and update the plan criteria as the business changes (for example VIP tier threshold adjustments or new market launches).

•
Document SOPs, metric definitions, and methods for VIP growth, and drive alignment and reuse across regions.

•
Act as the middle office hub between RM teams, regional markets, Product, Risk, and Finance, taking strategies through its entire lifecycle.

Gather feedback from frontline teams and users, combine it with business data to find common needs, and help improve the product experience, service processes, and operating tools.

业务洞察与策略制定

•
从数据中识别结构性问题及业务机会，例如高价值用户的流失信号、不同客户群体的服务需求差异，以及资源投入的边际回报等，并将分析结果转化为可执行的业务策略。

•
面向管理层撰写业务洞察报告，为VIP权益设计、资源配置及团队业务打法提供决策依据。

搭建并持续维护VIP业务核心指标体系，进行日常数据监控；针对指标异常波动及时定位根因，并提出明确、可执行的后续建议。

将周期性分析及报告自动化，通过数据看板或定时任务完成周报、月报、激励方案结果分析及异常预警等工作，减少重复性人工取数。

•
与数据仓库及商业智能团队协作，统一指标定义并建设相关数据表，确保数据准确、口径一致且全程可追溯。

负责VIP业务团队激励方案的设计与策略制定，包括指标选择、目标拆解、权重设置及激励结果挂钩机制。

跟踪激励方案的执行情况，按周、按月输出结果，并结合业务变化持续调整方案标准，例如VIP等级门槛调整或新市场上线等。

title: Account Executive
description:
TL;DR

Fast-growing measurement company looking for a seller to build pipeline and win new business with agencies and brands. This is a full-cycle sales role: you'll prospect, run discovery, take part in pitches, and learn to close alongside senior sellers. Ideal if you're ready for your first full AE seat, whether you're coming from an SDR/BDR role, account management, or agency-side media. You should understand how digital media works and be excited to sell a category that's still being defined.

Who we are

Adelaide is the leader in one of the fastest-growing areas of advertising: attention measurement and activation.

Since 2020, we've become the trusted media quality measurement partner for 40% of Fortune 50 brands who rely on our award-winning AU metric to plan smarter campaigns, invest in high-quality inventory, and dive stronger business outcomes. Adweek has called Adelaide 's AU " the attention economy's most widely recognized metric," and AdExchanger named it "Best measurement/Analytics Capability."

Our business continues to scale rapidly, outperforming the industry with a 35% three-year CAGR. What began as a 9-person startup in 2019 is now a team of more than 75.

The past year brought meaningful expansion. We launched the AU ecosystem, giving brands, media agencies, and publishers a unified way to leverage and transact on AU. We broadened our programmatic footprint with custom bidding in GoogleDV360 and pre-bid targeting in The Trade Desk, and grew our partner roster to over 125 platforms and publishers. Leading brands like Dell, Diageo, an Jaguar Land Rover-along with premium publishers such as Hearst, Spotify, and The New York Times-continue to demonstrate AU's value across the media lifecycle.

Adelaide is backed by prominent investors such as Human Ventures (Joe Marchese), Aperiam Ventures (Joe Zawadzki & Eric Franchi), WGI (Jonah Goodhart), and Irwin Gotlieb.

We have a NYC office and a London WeWork, but operates as a remote-friendly company with flexible work options.

How we work

We're a team of action-oriented doers-management rolls up their sleeves and contributes every day. Our culture is rooted in curiosity and rigor: opinions are held lightly, debated openly, and strengthened through testing. Everyone is encouraged to play a role in shaping planning and strategy.

We're built on belonging and growth-94% of employees report a strong sense of belonging, and 87% say they’re happy at work.

Position overview

This position reports to the VP of Sales (West) and focuses on building pipeline and winning new business with agencies and brands. Your day-to-day will center on researching target accounts, running outbound outreach, and setting meetings with agency and brand decision-makers across Analytics, Activation, and Planning, then carrying those opportunities forward with support from senior sellers. You'll help prepare and deliver pitches and work with our Product, Customer Success, and Technical Account Management teams to get pilots live and support client retention. You'll keep your pipeline clean in HubSpot and represent Adelaide at industry events.

You'll start with a territory, a strong product, a category with real momentum, and senior sellers who will teach you how to run a full cycle. You won't inherit a book of business, so you'll build your own. Over time, you'll take on larger accounts and own more of the close.

This is a remote role with regional requirements; candidates must reside in the Los Angeles area to support in-market meetings and client engagement.

Compensation:

The scope and level of responsibility will be calibrated based on experience, with opportunities to take on increasing autonomy and strategic impact over time.

This role offers a competitive compensation package consisting of a base salary plus performance-based commission, with commission making up approximately 35% of total On-Target Earnings (OTE).

Base Salary Range: $95,000 - $110,000

OTE Range : $146,000 - $170,

title: Security Compliance Lead
description:
About the team

Plaid’s Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team enables the business by proactively managing information security risk and maintaining effective controls. We partner across the company to keep Plaid’s platform secure, resilient, and aligned with industry and regulatory expectations.

Our assurance program builds trust with customers, consumers, and data partners. Core compliance is how we prove it. We run the certifications, audits, and regulatory obligations that let banks, customers, and regulators rely on Plaid, and we keep them aligned with a product that keeps changing.

About the role

As Security Compliance Lead, you’ll be the single accountable owner of Plaid’s core security compliance program: SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and their governance obligations. Banks, enterprise customers, and regulators rely on what you own when they decide to work with Plaid, and your work keeps those certifications and commitments reliable and on time as the business grows.

You will set the program’s structure and direction, with a roadmap and KPIs that turn compliance from a pass/fail event into a program leadership can steer. The control catalog you build will sit behind every audit, so one control and one piece of evidence can satisfy many obligations, from SOC 2 to FedRAMP. Your internal audits will find gaps before an external auditor, customer, or regulator does. You will make sure compliance shapes product decisions before launch instead of reacting to them.

As Plaid expands into new products, markets, and frameworks, you will build a program that keeps pace without adding headcount, using AI and automation.

Responsibilities

- Own the compliance program and governance calendar: Lead SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 27701 end to end. Run the annual and quarterly governance obligations (policy reviews, access and change-management reviews, security training, vendor reviews, and regulatory, bank, and partner assessments), each with an owner, a date, and evidence of completion.

- Build and own the control catalog: Design and maintain one control catalog mapped across every framework Plaid reports against, built to FedRAMP and NIST 800-53 depth, with clear control owners, quarterly owner certification, and testing.

- Run internal audit and policy assurance: Build a risk-based internal audit plan that tests operating effectiveness and whether policies are followed, and own the policy lifecycle. Track findings to remediation, and partner with Finance on ITGCs.

- Set direction and measure the program: Define what a mature program looks like, set the roadmap and KPIs to get there, and report progress to security leadership each quarter.

- Embed GRC by design: Track product roadmaps and supporting infrastructure with Product and Engineering. You will assess how launches and material changes affect audit scope and system boundaries, and build lightweight checkpoints into product discovery.

- Scale through AI and automation: Build repeatable processes, runbooks, and AI-driven automation for evidence, testing, scoping, and audit requests.

Qualifications

Must haves:

- Compliance program ownership:

- Has been the accountable owner of SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001/27701 programs through multiple audit cycles, including setting the roadmap and KPIs that matured them

- Has built or rebuilt a common control framework mapped across multiple frameworks, with control owners and testing

- FedRAMP:

- Hands-on FedRAMP experience (Rev5 or 20x): NIST 800-53 control implementation, boundary and SSP documentation, third-party assessment, and continuous monitoring

- Internal audit, policy assurance, ITGC, and SOX:

- Has planned and run risk-based internal audits that test operating effectiveness and policy adherence, and has driven findings to remediation

- Has worked with Finance or internal controls teams and external auditors on ITGCs and SOX

title: Sr Talent Partner
description:
About Us
We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That’s not a policy. It’s just who we are.
What keeps us going is what we hear from our Community. Families tell us they used to wake up every morning with a knot in their stomach. They don’t anymore. They tell us our product changed their relationship with their parents, from anxious and fearful to present and connected. It’s genuinely important work, and we don’t take it lightly.
If that’s the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years on, one with real scale, real mission, real momentum, and a real Community of people behind it, we’d love to talk.
Why this role exists
Most companies fill their first recruiting seat with someone who runs a process. We're not doing that. We've hired recruiters before who could source and coordinate but couldn't tell us who was actually good. We ended up doing the real evaluation ourselves every time, which meant the hire added activity, not leverage. This role is built to fix that specifically: we're hiring for judgment first, process second.
You'll own full-cycle recruiting across every function starting day one, and you'll build the operating system: sourcing, interview loops, scorecards. But the actual bar is narrower and harder than "can you run a process": can we trust your read on a candidate enough to act on it without redoing the work ourselves?
What you'll own

• Full-cycle recruiting (sourcing, evaluation, closing) across GTM, engineering/product, and ops.

• The recruiting operating system: ATS, interview structure, scorecards, sourcing channels, built from scratch, not inherited.

• Direct partnership with the CEO/COO and hiring managers on role scoping and hiring bar: you help set the bar, not just fill against it.

• Hiring metrics that actually inform decisions (time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, quality of hire), not vanity throughput numbers.

• Candidate experience and employer brand: often a candidate's first real signal of what working here is like.

What we're testing for

• Independent, evidence-based candidate judgment. As part of the process, you'll evaluate real, anonymized candidate profiles from our own hiring history, and we'll compare your read to what actually happened. This is the single most important thing we're screening for, more than years of experience or past titles.

• Sourcing alpha. Knowing what circles the best candidates swim in and generating conversations with great people who might be least likely to apply through LinkedIn.

• Full-cycle recruiting experience at an early-stage or fast-growing company, ideally as a founding or very early recruiting hire.

• Intelligence and clarity of thinking. During the calibration phase, for example, we're asking if you can contribute to the discovery of the ideal candidate profile.

• Range across functions: equally comfortable evaluating a growth hire and an engineer in the same week.

• A track record of delivering results and taking end-to-end responsibility for them, not just operating inside someone else's system.

• Comfort with ambiguity and founder-speed decision-making. There's no recruiting manager above you, just the CEO and COO.

Nice to have

• Recruiting experience in high growth, hardware, or consumer software subscription environments.

• Employer branding or content chops: job posts and outreach that actually convert.

• Prior experience leading or managing a recruiting team. We're growing quickly, and this role has a real path to building and leading a team, not just staying an individual contributor indefinitely.

The opportunity
This is a founding seat, not a fill-the-req seat. Whoever takes this defines how the company hires for years: the bar, the process, the tools, the brand. You'll start as an IC, closing key gaps yourself, but as we scale, there's a genuine opportunity to build and lead the recru

description:
Principal Data Scientist, AI (Architect-Level Scope)
About KLDiscovery

KLDiscovery is a global eDiscovery and legal technology provider serving large law firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies. We build and operate the products and services that legal teams rely on to manage, process, and review case data at scale. With operations across multiple countries and a client base that includes AmLaw 200 firms, we handle some of the largest and most complex matters in the industry.
About the Role
We're hiring our most senior AI practitioner - someone with genuine data science rigor who also wants to build. In this role, you'll set the scientific and architectural direction for gen AI and ML at KLDiscovery : designing the evaluation methodology that proves our AI holds up under legal scrutiny, choosing and validating the models and retrieval systems that power our products, and building the hardest parts of that system yourself.
This is one of the most interesting data science problem sets in enterprise software. You'll work with terabytes of real-world legal data - emails, contracts, chat transcripts, images, video, depositions, and regulatory filings - from some of the largest litigation and investigation matters in the world. The work is hard in ways that matter: documents are messy and adversarial, the stakes are real (privilege, defensibility, attorney work product), and getting the evaluation wrong has real consequences. AI that can surface key people, themes, and timelines in hours instead of weeks, or pre-classify millions of documents for relevance and privilege with results that survive scrutiny, directly changes the economics of how legal matters get resolved. We build solutions that turn data into evidence the legal system can trust.
This is a builder-first role, not a research-only or advisory one. You'll design experiments and evaluation frameworks that prove our AI is defensible in court, build the retrieval and agent systems that reason over case data, and personally ship the hardest, most novel parts of that system. You'll set strategic direction across Nebula, our eDiscovery platform, and CS & Operations, then prove out the science and the architecture by building it yourself. Not a role for anyone stepping back from the keyboard, and not a role for anyone who treats evaluation as an afterthought.
We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, equity, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $190,000 to $240,000.
Job location: Remote (candidate must be based in the United States)
Key Responsibilities
Own the science and the architecture, and build both personally. Design the experimentation and evaluation methodology that determines whether our AI's outputs are accurate, consistent, and defensible - then define the end-to-end gen AI architecture across Nebula and CS & Operations to deliver on it: LLMs, agent harnesses, RAG, vector search, embeddings, and model selection and triage. Build the hardest parts personally: prototype agent loops, design and run the evaluations that validate them, tune retrieval, and ship the shared infrastructure that powers AI Case Explorer (case overviews, timelines, key people and themes, PII surfacing, and Agent chat), AI Agent Review (pre-classifying relevance, privilege, and key issues, shipping MLP), and CS & Ops tech-enablement as part of our central work orchestration system.
Own evaluation rigor, AI/MLOps, and telemetry end-to-end. Design the statistical and experimental methodology behind our evaluation harnesses - the standard our outputs have to meet to hold up under legal scrutiny - and own the infrastructure that enforces it: model deployment

title: Lead Software Development Engineer
description:
About Amperity -Why This, Why Now
Most customer data is a lie by omission.
Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap-between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true-is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.
With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being-in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands-like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running-trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.
Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company-not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.
So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like-alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus-this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.
We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.
The Role
At Amperity , engineers work in small, collaborative feature teams. As an SDE IV, you'll contribute across teams that move quickly, embracing rapid, iterative development to solve meaningful customer problems and improve the platform. Engineers are involved in shaping what we build and how we build it, working with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams to create high-impact features and seamless customer experiences. Adaptabilidad: necesaria en proyectos técnicos dinámicos y de alta exigencia.

Vinculación a una compañía reconocida por su innovación en moldes industriales.
Participación en proyectos complejos, retadores y de alto impacto técnico.
Posibilidad de trabajo remoto con flexibilidad horaria según dinámica del rol.
Estabilidad laboral y oportunidades reales de crecimiento técnico.
Entorno colaborativo, especializado y orientado al desarrollo profesional.
IMPORTANTE PARA LOS CANDIDATOS
Esta posición está dirigida a personas que disfrutan la programación CAM, el mecanizado de precisión y la resolución de retos técnicos reales en entornos industriales.

title: BIM Designer & Coordinator: Civil
description:
About the Team

Industrial Compute develops the infrastructure that powers OpenAI’s AI systems. Our Design organization connects engineering, construction, and digital delivery to support complex data center campuses from initial planning through deployment.

Working with internal teams, design consultants, and construction partners, we develop coordinated designs that address site constraints, infrastructure requirements, and future growth. Our BIM team provides the models and workflows needed to deliver consistently across the portfolio.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Civil BIM Designer & Coordinator with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience to support the planning and design of large-scale, mission-critical data center campuses and associated power generation, energy storage, and utility facilities.

In this role, you will develop, coordinate, and maintain civil models using Civil 3D and AutoCAD. Your scope will include site layouts, grading, drainage, roads, and utilities, coordinating buildings with generating equipment, battery energy storage systems (BESS), water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, substations, and cooling systems.

You will work closely with civil engineers, BIM team, discipline designers, equipment vendors, and delivery partners to turn engineering requirements into clear models and deliverables. Your work will support early design reviews, resolve site coordination challenges, and establish repeatable civil BIM practices across concurrent projects. Detailed engineering requirements and specialist analyses will be provided by the responsible engineers.

We are looking for a hands-on civil specialist who can independently manage modeling assignments, communicate design dependencies, and maintain quality as projects evolve.

Key Responsibilities

- Advance feasibility, constructability, and phasing: Prepare layout, grading, routing, and earthwork options for early design reviews; incorporate noise, exhaust dispersion, heat-rejection, safety, and environmental constraints. Model heavy-equipment delivery routes, turning movements, crane areas, laydown, maintenance clearances, staged construction, temporary-to-permanent generation transitions, and future expansion.

- Lead civil site development: Create and maintain surfaces, grading and earthwork models, equipment and building pads, roads, alignments, profiles, and corridors. Incorporate flood protection, stormwater management, and containment or separation process-drainage requirements.

- Develop and coordinate plant utility systems: Model gravity and pressure networks for gas supply, cooling and process water, fire water, wastewater, electrical duct banks, and communications. Coordinate utility models, routes, corridors, crossings, connections, and clearances with engineers, consultants, utility providers, vendors, and construction partners.

- Integrate campus and power-generation infrastructure: Coordinate civil models with buildings, power plants, BESS, substations, water treatment plants, gas metering and conditioning facilities, cooling systems, and other site utilities. Support simple-cycle and combined-cycle gas turbine, reciprocating engine, and CHP layouts while incorporating equipment separation, service access, and fire access.

- Coordinate equipment, foundation, and thermal interfaces: Integrate vendor general arrangements, foundation footprints, equipment elevations, trenches, pits, and pipe-support locations with inputs from structural, geotechnical, mechanical, and electrical engineers. Coordinate civil interfaces for heat-recovery steam generators, steam-turbine facilities, heat exchangers, cooling towers, air-cooled condensers, radiator arrays, and thermal-distribution corridors.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - ML (London)
description:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.

We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.

THE ROLE:

We’re looking for Forward Deployed ML Engineers who want to work at the intersection of deep technical work and direct customer impact. As an ML FDE, you’ll partner with leading AI companies and foundation model labs to help them achieve state-of-the-art performance on their most demanding workloads: LLM serving, model training (SFT, RLHF), audio pipelines, scientific computing, and more. You’ll help teams reach outcomes most engineers can’t on their own.

The FDE team today includes world-class software engineers, computational scientists, ML engineers, and former founders. We’re looking for people with strong engineering fundamentals, deep curiosity across the AI stack, and energy for working directly with customers on hard problems.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

- Work hands-on with companies like Suno, Cognition, and Meta to architect and optimize production AI workloads on Modal

- Contribute to open-source projects (members of the team are active contributors to SGLang) and publish technical content that demonstrates Modal’s capabilities across the AI stack

- Collaborate with Modal’s product and sales teams, contributing to the platform as both an engineer and a product stakeholder

- Build trusted relationships with technical leaders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering, ML leads) at companies doing frontier AI work

- Conduct technical demos, experiments, and proofs of concept that make Modal’s performance advantages tangible

YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

- You have 2+ years of professional ML engineering experience, ideally with hands-on work in inference optimization, model training, GPU programming, or ML infrastructure

- You’re familiar with the serving (e.g., vLLM, SGLang) and training (e.g., slime, verl, TRL) toolchains and can go deep on at least one (you don’t need all of them)

- You’re a strong communicator who can go deep on technical architecture with an engineering team and clearly articulate tradeoffs to technical leadership

- You have a genuine interest in working directly with customers: you find it energizing to understand someone else’s problem and help them solve it

- You’re willing to work in person in London

NICE-TO-HAVE:

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or published work you’re proud of in ML or systems performance

title: Project Manager - Client Onboarding
description:
Project Manager, Client Onboarding
CrelioHealth Inc. · Remote (United States) · Full-time · Travel to client sites (~25-40%)
Compensation: $95,000 - $120,000 base, depending on experience + performance incentives (including incentives on expansion or referral opportunities you help close). Benefits include health coverage and PTO.
About CrelioHealth

CrelioHealth builds cloud-based laboratory information systems (LIS/LIMS) that power diagnostic labs across the United States and 2,500+ labs worldwide. Our platform runs the full lab workflow - from order booking and specimen tracking through result reporting, patient engagement, billing, and inventory - for physician office labs, hospital labs, reference labs, and direct-to-consumer testing companies. We are HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certified, and growing quickly in the US market.
The Role
When a lab signs with CrelioHealth , you are the person who turns that signature into a running lab. You will own client onboarding end to end: planning the implementation, configuring the rollout with our product and support teams, training lab staff, managing the go-live, and making sure the client is delighted enough to expand and refer. You are the face of CrelioHealth from kickoff to steady state.
This is not a sales role. You carry no quota and you will never cold-call. But onboarding is where trust is built, and trust is where growth comes from. We want someone who can confidently present the platform, handle a skeptical lab director, and spot the moment a client is ready for another module or another location - and who earns incentives when those opportunities convert.
What You Will DoOwn implementations

• Lead onboarding projects for new US clients - single-site labs through multi-location networks - from kickoff through go-live and handover to support.

• Build and run the implementation plan: scope, milestones, data migration, instrument interfaces, integrations (EHR/EMR, billing, HL7/FHIR), user setup, and validation.

• Coordinate internal teams (product, engineering, support) and client stakeholders (lab directors, pathologists, techs, front-desk, billing, IT) to keep every go-live on schedule.

• Travel to client sites for kickoffs, go-lives, and training - roughly 25-40% of your time, varying with the project calendar.

Make clients successful

• Train lab staff on real workflows - accessioning, worklists, QC, reporting, patient portal - and adapt the training to how each lab actually operates.

• Anticipate and manage change resistance: a lab switching its LIS is changing how everyone works, and you will guide them through it.

• Track onboarding health (time-to-go-live, adoption, early ticket volume) and report status honestly to clients and leadership.

Champion the platform

• Present and demo CrelioHealth confidently - to the client team that signed, and to the wider staff who did not choose it but must love it.

• Identify expansion opportunities during onboarding (additional modules, locations, or referrals) and hand them to the growth team - with incentives for you when they close.

• Feed what you learn on the ground back into product and our onboarding playbook, which you will help write.

What We Are Looking For (Must-haves)

•
4-7 years of project management experience , with at least 2 years implementing or onboarding software for external clients.

•
Healthcare experience is required ; hands-on time in a clinical laboratory or laboratory environment is strongly preferred - as a lab tech, lab manager, LIS analyst, or implementer of lab systems (LIS/LIMS, EHR, RCM).

• Fluency with lab operations concepts: specimen lifecycle, accessioning, QC/QA, instrument interfacing, CLIA/CAP context, HIPAA, and result reporting.

• Excellent presenter and communicator - comfortable running a room of skeptical clinicians, and equally comfortable on a video call with a solo lab owner.

title: Head of Social Marketing
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

Location: Open to Remote USA, but San Francisco, CA is preferred (hybrid)

ROLE OVERVIEW

CodeRabbit grew to $100M in just over a year, and growth is accelerating. More than 20,000 customers use CodeRabbit, and developers love both the product and the brand. In response to this marketing demand, we are building out a world-class marketing function made up of top talent with the budget and authority required to win. As part of that, we're hiring our first Head of Social Marketing to own CodeRabbit's entire social presence and make us a trusted voice in the conversations shaping the future of agentic software development.

You won't start from scratch. We're active across every channel, with X and LinkedIn as our focus, extensive partnerships on Instagram and short-form video, strong agency support, as well as strong influencer and amplification programs. You'll bring clever thinking, a proven methodology, and a data-driven approach to understand what's working. You’ll use your known-how to build out executive and community programs, and drive a playful, rabbit-led personality across the company, product and people.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own strategy, methodology, and execution for CodeRabbit's social presence across X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Instagram, and other channels

- Manage social communications across corp comms, product news, customer engagement, influencer programs, and exec comms

- Get CodeRabbit into the right conversations with architects, engineering managers, CTOs and technical thought leaders

- Grow community engagement and turn customer love into advocacy

- Own paid socialManage our agency partners and amplification platforms

- Establish goals and build analytics to drive measurable impact on awareness, engagement, and business results

- Partner closely with PR, analyst relations, customer advocacy, DevEx and community, and product marketing

QUALIFICATIONS

- Deep social marketing experience at a technical or developer-facing company.

- Real understanding of technical products, how developer communities work and how to activate them

- Methodology and analytics: a track record of using data to shape content, positioning and timing

- Experience running executive or founder social programs

- Experience combining organic and paid social to scale what works

- Experience owning a brand's full social presence

- Comfortable operating at the pace of a hyper-growth AI company

- Bring passion, initiative, intelligence and integrity to your work

- Experience marketing developer tools or AI products

- Experience managing agencies, influencer, and creator programs at scale

- Experience building community on developer platforms

- Comfort using AI tools and agents to scale content creation and analytics

OUR VALUES

- Collaborative Humans: Prioritizing collective intelligence

- Fearless Innovators: Turning obstacles into growth opportunities

- Persistent Passionate Developers: Thriving on complex, long-term challenges

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Synthesia is used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. The largest deployments now run thousands of creators across dozens of markets, languages, and compliance regimes. What decides whether those accounts expand or stall is not another avatar - it's whether admins, legal teams, and programme owners can actually stay in control.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Own the Enterprise surface end-to-end, from problem framing to shipped outcomes and iteration - often dealing with ambiguity. You'll reach out to the right stakeholders, get the right eyes in the room, and make decisions independently.

- Design complex governance and compliance systems that give admins, legal teams, and compliance officers genuine control and transparency. Examples include:

- Permission models and role hierarchies that scale across thousands of creators without collapsing into chaos.

- Audit log experiences that make compliance auditable - not just for the system, but for the humans who need to understand what happened.

- Workspace setup and identity workflows that integrate with real enterprise infrastructure (SSO, SCIM, MCP).

- License and billing models that admins can actually understand and manage at scale.

- Analytics and reporting that tell admins whether their deployment is working as intended.

- Drive pragmatic iteration. You'll scope ruthlessly, build POCs to get signal early, and iterate based on what you learn from enterprise customers.

- Set a design vision for our Enterprise surface and influence adjacent product areas to stay coherent. As things scale across SSO, compliance, analytics, and billing, you're keeping the mental model consistent.

YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU BRING:

- Significant experience designing complex, large-scale product surfaces - ideally admin dashboards, governance layers, analytics platforms, or other domains where system thinking matters.

- Technical fluency. You understand APIs, integrations, how services communicate, how widgets and developer hubs work. You can read a technical architecture doc and understand the constraints it creates for design. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.

- Systems thinking: not just about interaction flows, but about enterprise systems. You understand how identity systems, compliance regimes, and scale constraints shape what's actually possible in the UX. Y

title: Capital Markets Partnerships Lead
description:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books - all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Capital Markets Partnerships Lead to build the partner network that allows our clients to access the financing they need to grow their businesses without leaving the Rho platform.

Your accountability in one sentence: build and manage the relationships with firms that can lend to the strategic segments Rho serves, so Rho offers lending through partners. Done right, your work wins deals against competitors that lack these capabilities and retains scaling clients who need venture debt.

This is a build-from-zero seat on the Partnerships team. You'll report to our Head of Partnerships and work daily with Sales, Post-Sales, and Product. We're in-office in New York City or San Francisco.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build the lender partner network across our starting segments: capital-intensive industries, government-contract-oriented industries, and CPG and small-business lending - plus venture debt for scaling clients.

- Source, evaluate, and sign lending partners, then own those relationships ongoing - the signature is the start, not the win.

- Stand up the deal-routing motion: move inbound lending demand out of ad-hoc post-sales handling into a structured referral flow with clear owners in Sales and post-sales.

- Bring partner lending capability into live deals where it wins competitive business or retains a scaling client.

- Lay the groundwork for fund banking lending downstream as the network matures.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Deep lending fluency - you know how lenders evaluate, price, and structure credit - ideally built at a platform lending to startups (venture debt). Domain background is strongly preferred, not a hard requirement: we would also consider an exceptional generalist with strong adjacent lending experience and clear evidence they ramp fast.

- Ideally, partnerships experience at a fintech lending marketplace or similar: you've sourced, signed, and managed lending partners yourself.

- Credible in front of both lenders and clients in our target segments - defense and government-contract, capital-intensive, and CPG/SMB.

- A zero-to-one operator: you turn scattered inbound into a structured motion with routing, owners, and metrics.

- You already use AI to move faster - research, drafting, partner pipeline hygiene - and you're curious what's next.

- Based in New York City or San Francisco and excited to work in office with the team.

NICE TO HAVE

- Existing relationships with venture debt funds and specialty lenders (government-contract, asset-based, or CPG-focused).

- Experience structuring referral or revenue-share partnerships in a regulated environment.

The budgeted total cash compensation for this role (base plus variable, targeted at an 80/20 split) carries a midpoint of approximately $203,000, with a top of band of $238,000. Compensation may vary depending on relevant experience, skills, and business needs. In addition to cash compensation, Rho offers equity, healthcare benefits and paid time off.

Diversity is a core value at Rho. We're passionate about building and sustaining an inclusive and equitable environment for all those involved with our mission, including employees, contractors, candidates, customers and vendors. We believe every member of the Rho community enriches our ability to provide a broad range of ways to understand and engage with the market, identify problems, and drive solutions that align with our mission. We welcome all qualified applications and support each of our Rho'ers with ongoing professional growth opportunities.

title: (Senior ) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d)

We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our (Senior) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d), you build and run the verification process that proves our safety controller and the safety software on our robots do what the safety requirements say, release after release. You own the evidence that our certification body reviews. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

You will join the Safety & Compliance team in Munich, which is developing a new safety controller in-house while keeping the safety-software system on our robots today certified and moving forward. Verification has not had a dedicated owner so far, so you create the structure, the catalog and the process rather than only executing an existing one. You work daily with the safety (software) engineers and with TÜV to define what must be verified. Early on, you set up and prove the verification system for the current system, and you then carry it into the certification of the new controller.

Your Responsibilities

- Own the verification of our new safety controller end to end, from the verification plan to the certification evidence (target PL d per ISO 13849-1:2023 and SIL 2 per IEC 61508)

- Build the complete verification catalog and set up the verification process and structure from scratch

- Verify the safety software at unit and integration level with automated tests including fault and robustness cases, structural coverage, static analysis, and code and requirement reviews

- Automate verification so that it runs on every change

- Verify the controller and its safety functions as part of the robot arm against ISO 10218-1:2025

- Keep traceability from risk assessment to test results and write reports that hold up in an audit

- Work closely with the safety (software) engineers and TÜV to define what must be verified

- Review the verification work of your colleagues and share your practices with the team

- A degree in a technical field such as software, electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience

- 3+ years of experience verifying or testing safety-critical embedded systems in industrial automation, automotive, rail, aerospace or medical devices

- Enough embedded C to write white-box tests and to find defects in a code review

- Working knowledge of IEC 61508-3 or its industry counterpart (ISO 26262-6, EN 50716, DO-178C) and the verification evidence it requires

- Hands-on lab skills with oscilloscope, logic analyser and debugger, including measuring a reaction time you can defend

- Nice to have:

- Experience with EtherCAT and Safety over EtherCAT (FSoE) or another safety protocol such as PROFIsafe or CIP Safety is a plus

- Experience with ISO 10218-1:2025, ISO 13849-1:2023 or IEC 62061, HIL tooling, coverage and static analysis tools (e.g. VectorCAST, TESSY, LDRA, Polyspace), MISRA C, robot kinematics, or working with a certification body such as TÜV is a plus

- Clear technical writing and fluent English (C1+); German is a plus

How you'll make an impact

- You drive complex, ambiguous work to clear outcomes and raise the quality of your colleagues' work through review and mentorship.

- You translate goals into plans independently, identify improvements to processes and tooling, and make most decisions in your area.

- You bring specialized expertise and cross-functional knowledge, and solve complex problems with strong analytical and contextual judgment.

Why join RobCo?

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

- Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their envir

description:
Landing page & Onboarding Conversion Specialist (Dating, Visa, & Travel)

• Can you spot the weak parts in a funnel and come up with tests to fix them?

• Can you use any CRM or split testing tool successfully by tinkering around for a few hours?

• Can you set up your own tests, including everything from creating the copy, changing the layout, and configuring the javascript tags?

• Are you fluent enough in funnel analytics so you can diagnose WHERE users drop off and WHY, not just report that they did?

• Can you ship 3-5 tests per week in different funnels without breaking things, and read the data cleanly enough to call a winner?

• Do you have experience with Manychat, WhatsApp, Phone Calls, email, etc, as parts of onboarding flows?

• Can you set up or coordinate with ad teams to introduce and optimize remarketing flows on external ad networks?

• Can you quickly and accurately figure out which ads are profitable once you get access to raw data from different sources?

Position Overview:
The Marketing Specialist for New User Onboarding & Lifecycle focuses on increasing revenue and profitability across Together Light Inc .'s dating, visa, and travel business units. This role is primarily focused on optimizing the complete new user journey, from the first touch to full activation. To some extent, the role may be involved with re-engaging past users and testing ad platform content for congruence and conversion.
Your main area:

• Initial Onboarding Flow: Owning the user's experience from the moment they submit an email/phone number.

• Landing Page Optimization: Constant A/B testing and refining all lead capture and remarketing landing pages to maximize conversion.

• First 5-Minutes: Analyzing and improving the first few pages and first few minutes of the new user interface (UI) to drive immediate engagement and activation.

• Reboarding & Remarketing: Creating and managing flows to re-activate dormant users and convert leads from remarketing campaigns.

Examples of Typical Responsibilities (in no particular order):
Landing Page & UI Optimization:

• Develop/test new Call-to-Action (CTA) on new user landing pages.

• Run split tests on UI elements, copy, and page flows for the initial "member's area" experience to reduce drop-off.

• Create and manage continual champion/challenger testing for remarketing landing pages to win back past users.

Onboarding Flow Optimization:

• Take complete ownership of the email, SMS, and push notification sequences for the first 7 days of a new user's life.

• Map, analyze, and optimize the user's journey through the first few pages of the desktop and mobile app interfaces.

• Create and test resource guides, how-to videos, and FAQs specifically designed to be delivered during the initial onboarding period.

Reboarding & Re-engagement:

• Design and implement "reboarding" email and SMS flows for users who sign up but do not activate.

• Develop targeted campaigns for past users or leads, coordinating with internal teams to drive re-engagement.

Analytics & Strategy:

• Debug all flows (links, grammar, load times) to ensure a seamless user experience.

• Prepare reports and track KPIs specifically related to onboarding conversion rates, user activation, and re-engagement success.

• Experiment with alternate versions of offers (e.g., alternate pricing, trial memberships, new VSLs) targeted at new and re-engaging users.

• Propose, implement, and analyze results from continual A/B split testing on all funnels.

title: Senior Manager, Partner Program Ecosystem Co-Sell
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

The Senior Manager, Partner Program Ecosystem Co-Sell owns how Everpure rewards, funds and enables partners to co-sell joint solutions, and makes sure every dollar of partner investment returns measurable pipeline and revenue. You design and run the partner program and its investment model, build the value exchange with ecosystem partners (technology, cloud, GSI, distributor and reseller), and turn those partnerships into repeatable joint solution selling through a "Meet in the Channel" motion: meeting customers where they already buy, through and with partners.

This role can be staffed from the Santa Clara, New York, Chicago, or Durham offices.

What you will do

You are accountable for a partner program that is simple to join, rewards partners for co-selling, and returns more than it costs. The role covers program design and operations; alliance go-to-market and joint solution development sit with other teams.

Partner program and benefits design

• Design the global partner program framework supporting co-sell sales motion

• Design benefits that support an ecosystem of partners co-selling together, such as tier-based rebates, incentives, MDF, NFR, enablement, and co-marketing funds, and set clear eligibility for each.

• Evolve the program each year from partner feedback, field input, and performance data; retire benefits that do not change partner behavior.

• Run the program calendar, launches, and partner communications so partners and field teams know what changed and why.

Value exchange design

• Define the value exchange for each partner type: what Everpure invests and what the partner commits in return (certified people, pipeline, customer outcomes, co-sell participation).

title: Manager, Technical and Global Accounting
description:

With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. The ideal candidate has sound judgment and is comfortable with ambiguity. They set direction, make the call when it needs to be made, and are committed to developing others. - Partner with Tax, Legal, FP&A, Payroll, Accounts Payable, Product, and Commercial on allocations, cross-charges, and complex transactions. Engage early on new products and arrangements so leaders understand the accounting implications
