title: Talent Acquisition Partner (Recruitment) · Permanent · Remote-First
description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle - creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

TALENT ACQUISITION PARTNER

Permanent, Full-Time | Remote-First

Internal Recruitment | Kyra | Remote-First

Start date: As soon as possible. Please let us know your notice period.

Contract: Permanent, full-time employment.

Location: Remote-first, based in Europe. If you're near London, we'd be happy to meet in person during onboarding, but it's not a requirement.

Salary: We're open to different levels of experience. Please share your salary expectations and currency in the application form.

👋 THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for an experienced in-house recruiter to help us build the team behind Kyra.

We're hiring across different markets, disciplines and specialist skill sets, including priority roles supporting some of our biggest client accounts.

The challenge isn't always finding candidates. It's knowing exactly who to look for.

A hiring brief rarely tells the whole story. We need someone who can get under the bonnet of a team's challenges, question assumptions and identify the skills that will make the biggest difference.

Someone who can find those people, help us test for those skills and make better hiring decisions.

But we also want to think beyond the immediate vacancy. Every search should strengthen our knowledge of the market, our relationships and our ability to hire next time.

The goal? Better hiring decisions, faster searches and a talent network that becomes a competitive advantage.

You'll have ownership of your work, the opportunity to shape how we recruit and the freedom to test new ideas.

🏃 CAN YOU KEEP PACE?

Four qualities I look for in a recruiter.

P: People Person

Networking comes naturally. You can strike up a conversation with almost anyone and enjoy meeting people from different backgrounds and professions.

You listen carefully, remember the details and know how to build relationships that last. You're equally comfortable engaging a senior leader or someone taking their first steps into a career.

A: Adaptable

Different personalities, markets, hiring managers and priorities. You read situations well, welcome feedback and know when to change your approach.

You're comfortable working through ambiguity without losing sight of what needs to get done.

C: Curious & Up for a Challenge

You're fascinated by what makes people good at what they do.

You ask questions others miss, challenge assumptions and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar subjects.

You understand that the most important skills aren't always obvious from a CV or job title.

E: Effective at Pace

You have at least three years' recruitment experience in a startup, scaleup or similarly fast-paced, high-volume hiring environment.

You're a confident headhunter who can manage multiple searches, prioritise competing demands and move quickly without compromising standards.

Bonus points for experience recruiting across Europe and the US, particularly in creative, marketing, technology or growing businesses.

We also value excellent writing, commercial awareness, confidence with recruitment data and ATS tools, and an appetite for experimenting with AI.

🔎 WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You'll take responsibility for priority hiring across the business while helping us build a recruitment approach that improves with every search.

- Understand the problem: Work closely with hiring managers to understand their commercial challenges and identify the specific skills their teams need.

- Find the people: Headhunt, research talent markets and build relationships with people we might otherwise miss.

- Test for skills: Help hiring managers look beyond CVs and assess what candidates can actually do.

- Follow through: Manage candidate

title: Tech Lead, Approvals

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

YOUR ROLE

The Approvals team owns the approval and task framework that runs every workflow at Zip: routing, conditions, recalculation, approver assignment, and the Approvals experience, including the request details page, AI Summaries, and mobile. Other teams, including payments, risk orchestration, and contracts, build on top of what we ship, so our work reaches every customer.

Approvals have to be correct. If an approval doesn't fire, or goes to the wrong person, it becomes a SOX compliance issue for enterprise customers like Block, General Mills, Visa, and Anthropic. We focus on two areas: governance, so customers and their auditors can trust the platform, and procurement automation, where we are bringing AI into approvals. For example, we are building on Zip's AI chat to help customers understand why a request was assigned to someone, or why an approval did or didn't trigger.

We are hiring a Tech Lead for the governance and automation side of the team. You will set the technical direction for our governance and compliance roadmap and our AI initiatives, working with the Engineering Manager and product to turn open-ended problems into a vision, milestones, and a plan, and then lead the technical delivery. You will partner with another tech lead on the team who leads our experience work, including the request details page and our new mobile app. This is a Staff-leaning scope with more leadership than a typical senior role: you will be evaluated on the results of the team and the initiatives you lead, and you will still write code. You will report to the Engineering Manager, Approvals.

Why you'll love this role:

- Own the foundation. Every Zip product team builds on Approvals, so making it faster and easier to build on helps teams across the company launch faster.

- High visibility. We own some of Zip's most important pages. The request details page we recently redesigned is seen by every customer every day, and leadership cares about it.

- Real technical depth. Performance and correctness at scale for enterprise customers, plus the chance to modernize a legacy framework we own.

- Shape our AI roadmap. Bring AI into approvals and procurement automation, with room to define what we build next.

- Lead a growing team. The team is nine engineers today and growing to 10 or 11, with a path to bigger scope or into engineering management if you want it.

- A team that listens. We run monthly retros and make process changes with everyone's buy-in. We take quality seriously, with code owners on critical areas, a 24-hour review SLA, and leadership that backs engineers who block low-quality PRs.

YOU WILL

- Lead, mentor, coach, and grow the Approvals engineering team through design discussions, code reviews, and hands-on guidance, giving engineers room to take ownership.

- Set the technical direction and make architecture and design decisions for our governance and compliance roadmap and our AI initiatives.

title: Software Engineer - Inference Product
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

We're looking for product-minded backend and distributed systems engineers to build the API layer that powers Model APIs, Baseten's hosted endpoints for the latest open-source models. Every request to Model APIs passes through the systems this team owns: authentication, rate limiting, routing, metering and billing. You'll make that layer fast, reliable and easy to build on, and use it to ship new products that change how developers use models at scale. You'll work where infrastructure meets product. The systems you build decide how customers experience performance, how capacity is shared across a global GPU fleet, and how inference is packaged and sold. You'll join a small, high-impact team that partners closely with inference, and product, and you'll own your work from design through production. This role is ideal for engineers who like owning high-scale production systems, care about developer experience, and want their work to directly shape how AI infrastructure is priced, packaged and delivered.

 

EXAMPLE INITIATIVES

You'll get to work on these types of projects on our Inference Platform:

- Introducing Baseten Grid https://www.baseten.co/blog/introducing-baseten-grid/

- Introducing Baseten Hosted Tools https://www.baseten.co/blog/introducing-baseten-hosted-tools/

- Frontier Gateway https://www.baseten.co/blog/introducing-baseten-frontier-gateway/

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Build and operate the API layer behind Model APIs: request handling, authentication, rate limiting and routing, with high availability and low added latency.

- Own usage metering and billing infrastructure: accurate, real-time accounting for every request, and the flexibility to support new pricing and packaging models.

- Build the rate-limiting and capacity systems that balance customer throughput against fleet utilization, at scale and in real time.

- Ship new products at the API layer that change how developers use models, from routing across models to features that make building on Model APIs easier.

- Turn platform capabilities into a strong product experience: usage visibility, self-serve controls, and clear, predictable API behavior.

- Instrument the edge with deep observability and alerting, so issues are caught and fixed before customers notice.

- Partner with the Model APIs, inference, and product teams to get new capabilities to customers quickly and safely.

- Own projects end to end, from design through deployment, on-call and iteration on customer feedback.

 

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3+ years building and operating distributed systems, backend infrastructure, or large-scale APIs where reliability, latency, and scale are first-class concerns.

- A proven track record of owning low-latency, reliable backend services, including rate limiting, auth, quotas, metering, and migrations.

- Infrastructure instincts with a feel for performance: profiling, tracing, capacity planning, and SLO management.

- Comfort debugging performance and reliability issues across multiple layers of the stack, from application behavior down to runtime and infrastructure internals.

- A strong sense of developer experience. You think about how systems are used, not just how they work.

- Eagerness to learn new languages, frameworks, and s

title: Dealer Governance Specialist
description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

Role Purpose

Motorway is the UK’s fastest-growing used car marketplace - our online-only platform connects private car sellers with thousands of verified dealers nationwide, ensuring everyone gets the best deal.

The Dealer Governance role is pivotal in working with the Dealer Support Manager in maintaining an engaged and compliant Dealer community in our Marketplace. We will prioritise industry-leading policies and processes to enforce our guidelines for dealer operations. Working with the Dealer Support Manager, you will play a central role in creating scalable solutions to manage risks, working collaboratively across teams to ensure commercial awareness. Your responsibilities will include leading day-to-day enforcement activities and documenting and aligning them effectively. These activities span from managing dealer behaviour, cancellations to addressing dealer debt; all the time ensuring how we operate in this space is documented and consistent.

Your contribution to this role will significantly impact the safety, engagement and trustworthiness of our marketplace for sellers. You will actively contribute to the development of internal processes and risk matrices, enabling us to operationalise our Terms & Conditions effectively. These activities will support our dealers to maximise their potential on Motorway.

What you’ll be doing:

- Manage escalations & our review process through our ticketing system pertaining to dealer behaviour and conduct, proactively working towards mitigating future occurrences of known issues. This will include fairly issuing warnings & documenting these outcomes

- Support the team with initiatives to reduce Dealer-lead cancellations

- Completing all onboarding activities for new Dealers, ensuring compliance with T&Cs, Code of Conduct, and any other regulatory considerations

- Make well-informed decisions with commercial considerations using established frameworks when it comes to sanctioning dealers, including the possibility of banning them from the Motorway platform - you’ll ensure these decisions are consistent and based off of a documented process

- Fulfil any other reasonable duties as required.

What you’ll bring:

- You love supporting and working with customers and frontline operations teams

- You’ll be able to balance commercial awareness with compliance in your decisions

- An analytical approach, with an ability to spot trends in data and compel others to commit to the recommendations you propose

- You’ll have an interest or experience in working in a Marketplace environment

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt quickly in our fast-paced environment

- Comfortable liaising and communicating with a wide range of stakeholders; from Specialist to C-Suite level

- Dedication to excellent customer service, able to show empathy and understanding to the needs of your customers

- Excellent communication and writing skills

- A strong understanding of the motor industry is preferred but not essential

- Knowledge of automotive pricing systems such as CAP is preferred but not essential

About the role
The EAP Care Manager is a mental health professional who provides telephonic and/or live chat support to members accessing the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). This role delivers brief clinical assessment, crisis intervention, solution-focused support, referral coordination, and workplace consultation services. The Care Manager ensures high-quality member experience while adhering to clinical best practices, confidentiality standards, and organizational workflows.

Pay Rate:
$28-35 per hour, commensurate with experience.

Job Summary

• Provide telephonic and/or live chat needs assessment and screening while managing an inbound EAP phone/chat queue.

• Deliver brief, solution-focused, in-the-moment supportive interventions and psychoeducation for concerns including stress, anxiety, grief, relationship issues, and substance use.

• Participate in individual supervision, team meetings, and case consultation.

• Collaborate effectively with colleagues to ensure high-quality member care.

• Maintain reliable attendance and availability for scheduled shifts and caseload responsibilities.

• Complete required trainings and maintain competency in EAP protocols and procedures.

• Participate in the EAP on-call rotation to provide after-hours coverage (evenings, weekends, and holidays), typically assigned approximately two weeks per calendar year.

• Master’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or a related behavioral health or human services field.

• Two (2) years of clinical experience, preferably in Employee Assistance Programs (EAP), crisis intervention

title: Engineering Delivery Partner (m/f/d)
description:
We are looking for an Engineering Delivery Partner to support effective execution across several Engineering teams.
You will improve coordination, delivery transparency, communication, and ways of working. You will help teams identify and resolve blockers, risks, and dependencies while ensuring that decisions and actions are followed through to completion.
This role enables delivery but does not own product priorities, staffing, delivery commitments, or final delivery outcomes.
What you’ll do

• Facilitate planning, synchronization, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-team delivery discussions.

• Ensure meetings result in clear decisions, owners, next steps, and deadlines.

• Maintain visibility of blockers, risks, dependencies, handoffs, and open decisions.

• Follow up on actions and communication until ownership and closure are clear.

• Facilitate the resolution of delivery issues and escalate them when leadership decisions are required.

• Identify recurring coordination problems and systemic delivery bottlenecks.

• Lead practical improvement initiatives and evaluate their results.

• Use flow, predictability, capacity, dependency, and risk indicators to provide delivery insights.

• Improve delivery transparency and reporting through Jira.

• Adapt Scrum lightweight project-delivery practices to the team context.

• Support teams in strengthening collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Partner with Group Leads, Product, QA, Tech Leads, and other stakeholders.

Final prioritization, staffing, resource allocation, and delivery decisions remain with Engineering and Product leadership.
What we expect

• 5+ years of experience in Agile delivery, software delivery, team coordination, or a Scrum Master role.

• Experience supporting several Engineering teams or coordinating work in a complex delivery environment.

• Strong practical knowledge of Scrum.

• Ability to select and adapt practices rather than apply one methodology mechanically.

• Experience coordinating cross-team dependencies, blockers, risks, handoffs, actions, and decisions.

• Drive improvements in delivery predictability, flow efficiency, and cross-team execution.

• Experience leading delivery or process improvements with measurable results.

• Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and collaboration between Engineering and Product.

• Strong facilitation skills, including complex discussions and constructive conflict resolution.

• Ability to align stakeholders and influence without formal authority.

• Strong ownership, communication, systems thinking, and consistent follow-through.

• Experience using Jira.

• English sufficient for effective work in a distributed international environment.

Nice to have

• Experience coaching teams or other delivery professionals.

• Experience introducing delivery metrics and cross-team reporting.

• Russian, polish

What success looks like
During the first six months, you will help establish:

• Transparent tracking of dependencies, risks, blockers, decisions, and actions.

• Clear ownership and faster closure of open communication loops.

• Reliable visibility into delivery health and predictability.

• Measurable improvement in one or more recurring delivery bottlenecks.

• Delivery practices that fit the teams’ context rather than create unnecessary process overhead.

Role boundaries
The Engineering Delivery Partner facilitates coordination, provides visibility, and supports resolution.
The role does not:

• Set product priorities.

• Manage employees or conduct performance reviews.

• Allocate people or approve staffing decisions.

• Make final technical or product decisions.

• Commit teams to delivery dates.

• Own final delivery outcomes.

These responsibilities remain with the relevant Group Leads, Product leaders, and technical leaders.

The position is open to candidates currently based in Poland

title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Battery Pack
description:
About the Team

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and advancing toward AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world environments. Working across the full model and systems stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the physical constraints of real-world systems to improve people’s lives.

About the Role

As a Mechanical Design Engineer on the Robotics team, you’ll design battery packs for robots and help define how those packs integrate into the rest of the system. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you’ll own mechanical designs from early architecture and packaging through prototyping, validation, and production. You’ll work closely with electrical, thermal, systems, and manufacturing engineers to build packs that are safe, reliable, and practical to assemble and service.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA and requires in-person presence 4 days a week.

In this role, you will:

- Define battery pack architecture and packaging in collaboration with the engineers designing the rest of the robot.

- Design pack enclosures, structural components, mounts, and interfaces for cell or module integration.

- Make design tradeoffs across size, weight, stiffness, thermal performance, safety, assembly, and serviceability.

- Build and evaluate prototypes, using test results and teardown findings to improve the design.

- Release CAD and drawings, and work with suppliers and manufacturing partners to move designs into production.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Enjoy owning mechanical designs and staying hands-on through builds, testing, and debugging.

- Have strong intuition for how battery packs behave under shock, vibration, thermal cycling, and repeated use.

- Can make practical design decisions as requirements evolve and explain the tradeoffs to teammates across disciplines.

- Think about how hardware will be assembled, inspected, and serviced while it’s still on the drawing board.

- Have 4+ years of professional mechanical or hardware design experience, including direct ownership of battery pack hardware or a major pack subsystem for high-volume automotive, mobility, or legged robotics applications.

- Take mechanical designs from concept through prototyping, validation, and production release.

- Are proficient in 3D CAD, engineering drawings, GD&T, and tolerance analysis.

- Have experience designing pack enclosures, structures, or module-to-pack or pack-to-system interfaces. Experience with battery cell design is a plus.

About OpenAI

title: Field Access and Reimbursement Strategy and Enablement Director
description:
Why Patients Need You

Field & Patient Access is an evolving and highly important area for the success of Primary Care. Due to the complexity of the patient journey in many Primary Care therapeutic areas, up to 60% of primary care medications never get dispensed after an HCP writes the prescription. The role of Primary Care Access and Reimbursement is to remove barriers to access through education and streamlined processes that accelerate fulfillment, helping appropriate patients get access to the medication their HCP has prescribed.

What You Will Achieve

The Field Access & Reimbursement Strategy and Enablement Director will work across a broad, multi-disciplinary group of internal and external stakeholders to develop, evolve, and lead projects & programs to advance the Field Access and Reimbursement group’s mission to accelerate fulfillment for appropriate patients. They will develop a process of continuous improvement measured by clearly defined key performance indicators that serve as benchmarks for success across the platform. The Field Access & Reimbursement Strategy and Enablement Director brings organizational excellence, project management expertise, and analytical rigor together with a deep understanding of Access and Reimbursement priorities and operations - driving seamless execution of operating plans and supporting their continuous evolution.
This role advances Field Access and Reimbursement by continuously improving key operational areas: infrastructure, engagement frameworks, project management, documentation, training, the operating model, analytics and reporting, digital and information platforms, third-party license agreements, resourcing, meeting planning, and budget management - the latter in partnership with the Field and Patient Access Strategy and Enablement Team Lead. The Field Access & Reimbursement Strategy and Enablement Director reports to the Field and Patient Access Strategy and Enablement Team Lead.
How You Will Achieve It

• Work with Cross-functional Partners, Field Access and Reimbursement Leadership, Marketing/Commercial Leads, Medical Leadership, Legal, Compliance, Patient Services and others to identify key themes and lead initiatives/projects needed to advance productivity, efficiency, and results.

• Current support includes but is not limited to the Migraine portfolio, Vaccines portfolio, and future Primary Care launches (i.e. obesity)

• Identify and prioritize the right continuous improvement projects, processes, and resources, working with key stakeholders to advance productivity and support the strategy and execution of quarterly Latest Estimate forecast submissions and the annual Strategic & Operating Plans and budgets.

• Lead efforts to evolve Field Access and Reimbursement workflows and SOPs as needed, aligned to current guardrails and approved ways of working.

• Partner cross-functionally to improve training, build capability plans, and help roll out those plans for Field Access and Reimbursement teams and Regional Directors.

• Partner cross-functionally with key colleagues across functional areas (Patient Services, and others) to evolve, maintain, improve, and enhance Field Access and Reimbursement digital platforms and capabilities, ensuring ongoing alignment, consistency, and efficiency.

• Partner cross-functionally with internal teams and, as needed, external stakeholders to deliver insights and execute initiatives that evolve the Field Access and Reimbursement approach and drive results.

• Lead recurring readouts to leadership on Field Access and Reimbursement execution, combining quantitative metrics and qualitative insights as part of Control Tower reporting. Cadence defined by leadership or as needed.

• Analyze data and generate insights to inform strategic decisions at all levels of Primary Care Access & Reimbursement from the territory level to executive directives.

title: Senior Embedded Engineer - Intercom
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

About the Role

We are a small, dynamic team focused on building intelligent cloud-managed Intercom systems. Intercom is our second newest major product line and is off to the best start of any product in Verkada’s history. Our Intercom allows customers to receive calls from anywhere - at their desk or on their phone - with rich video and 2-way audio.  And we have a lot more to build.
We consider our team a startup within a startup, with a large amount of ownership and autonomy. You’ll be working alongside a dynamic team of firmware, backend, and frontend engineers to develop this product line.

What You'll Do

• Excited by new products, startups, and delivering real customer value

• You think about delivering best-in-class products and experiences - not features

• You can take a less-than-fully-fleshed-out product idea and drive it to completion

• Self-motivated problem solver: At Verkada, you will tackle large, complex problems with no clear answers.

• Teach and learn: You will learn new technologies while being entrusted with the technical ownership of major systems, and we hope to learn something from you in turn.

• Growth mindset: As a fast-growing startup, every day brings new challenges and opportunities for growth, and we want you to grow with us!

What You Bring

• BS or a graduate degree in Computer Science, Math, Engineering, or science

• 7+ years of experience working on Linux development as a Software Engineer.

• Proficient in C/C++

• Preferred experience working with embedded Linux, cameras, or audio systems

• Experiene with Yocto, Bash

• Familiar with Linux device drivers, Linux kernel patches, secure operating systems and security focused programming.

• Familiarity with RTOS, Secure Boot, WebRTC

• Understanding of HTTP and practical debugging techniques

• Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week

• Must be willing to travel internationally 2x a year

US Employee Benefits

Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

• Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans

• Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage

• Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options

• Expanded mental health support

• Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits

• Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time

• Professional
